_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the reader judge returned them, round 3 (the cap); each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark staged register lands; 1, 2 and 6 read in one glance; five frames held down: 3's lit third barely brighter, 8 blinds, 4 a mannequin, 5 repeats the cover at feed size, 9's split a diagonal stripe.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck, one night, one key; ember band changes state; the reliefs sit outside, 7 furthest.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; c24 and c8 apart; c5 and c6 apart; on-site detail via AJOT; c3 not listed in the first comment; slide 2 has no 'drawn to illustrate'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where; safety concrete; jobs as the company's word; the 'no figure' line only in the caption.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover and 2 pay, 6 turns; 5 cuttable; 7 interrupts; flat close.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Caption opener a Texan's; slides read like a wire summary with encoding notes.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Racks, lateral and worker at a gate repeat no. 68; ten of twenty repeats no. 69; floodlit repeats no. 67.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No subject at 432 px; the lit three barely brighter.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A real pool 25 L* above the grating, low rake so the dark panels cast and recede.
Pull back so all twenty box ends are lit as round ends with the bands on them; both beams cast.
Turn the figure three-quarters away, rim-lit from the flood, a contact shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Repeats the cover at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A low three-quarter from the rotary, slips, box mouth and arm in one diagonal.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The split reads as a stripe; plain pipe and posts.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop onto the rack's axis so the box ends face the lens as two blocks of ten.
